stories.title: System Game Creation
stories.text:
Feature: Game Creation
  As the system,
  I want to create a game when enough players have joined the queue,
  So that players can start playing.
  
  Scenario: Creating a game with the minimum number of players
    Given there is a queue for joining a game
    And at least 4 players are in the queue
    When I detect enough players
    Then I create a new game
    And the queued players are placed in the game
    
  Scenario: Creating a game with the maximum number of players
    Given there is a queue for joining a game
    And 36 players are in the queue
    When I detect 36 players
    Then I create a new game
    And the queued players are placed in the game
    
  Scenario: Handling players beyond the maximum limit
    Given there is a queue for joining a game
    And more than 36 players are in the queue
    When I detect enough players
    Then I create a new game with 36 players
    And the remaining players stay in the queue for the next game
    
  Scenario: Not enough players to create a game
    Given there are less than 4 players in the queue
    When 360 seconds have passed
    Then I notify the players they will have to wait longer
    And I play music for the players

linkedRequirements.text: The system must be able to create a game
The system must be able to accomodate 4 to 36 players
The system must be able to play sound effects
The system must be able to set a timer

stories.title: Joining a new queue
stories.text:
Feature: Joining a new queue
  As a player,
  I want to join a queue,
  So that I can be placed in a game when enough players have joined.

  Scenario: Successfully joining the queue
    Given I am not currently in a game
    And I am connected to the system
    When I request to join the queue
    Then I join the queue

  Scenario: Attempting to join a queue while already in a game
    Given I am already in an active game
    And I am connected to the system
    When I request to join the queue
    Then I receive an error message
    And I remain in my current game
    
  Scenario: Not connected to the system
    Given I am not currently in a game
    When I request to join the queue
    And I am not connected to the system
    Then I receive an error message

linkedRequirements.text: The player must be able to join the queue for a game
A player must be able to forfeit the game

stories.title: Request a cell
stories.text:
Feature: Input cell coordinates
  As a player,
  I want to input cell coordinates
  So that I can be given the appropriate challenge
  
  Scenario: Approved coordinates input
    Given I input coordinates
    And the system approves my coordinates
    Then I get a challenge
 
  Scenario: Dissaproved coordinates input
    Given I input coordinates
    But the system dissaproves my coordinates
    Then I am given an error message
    And I can input new coordinates

linkedRequirements.text: The player must be able to input cell cordinates

stories.title: Acquire a cell
stories.text:
Feature: Acquire a cell
   As a player, 
   I want to be able to complete the given challenge 
   So that Ι can acquire a cell
   
 Scenario: Succesful challenge completion
   Given Ι completed my challenge
   And the timer did not run out
   Then the system plays a success sound
   And I am given the cell
   
  Scenario: Unsuccesful challenge completion
    Given I failed my challenge
    Then the system plays a clown sound
    And I wait for the next round
    
  Scenario: Timer run out
    Given I am working on the challenge
    And I am not yet finished
    When the timer runs out
    Then the system plays a clown sound
    And I wait for the next round

linkedRequirements.text: The player must be able to acquire a cell
The player must be able to complete challenges
